scope: Second-seed mechanism assessment before any new external candidate score was read. No live prompt/config changes.
shared_channel_caveat: Pinned client drops collected normal output when a later error or timeout occurs. No returned measurement must not be equated with no measurement having been produced. Synthetic confirmation is not proof that a particular real lost observation was useful.

episodes.assessment: Freely chose a model/blend comparison. Used arrays where scalar scores were expected in blend weighting, raising ambiguous array truth error. Final plan acknowledged no new evidence; removed CatBoost and added text LR using old incumbent logs. Do not attribute its subsequent outcome to successfully returned diagnostic evidence.

Freely chose a five-fold configuration grid, exceeded diagnostic cap. Final plan acknowledged no new evidence and reused old zero-embedding-weight observation to drop that branch and tune text LR. A shared old-log response, not new evidence-based diagnosis.

Real check completed in approximately 53 seconds. Tree-prediction correlations did not meet its stated >0.92 condition; weak linear model did not improve the tested blend. Despite this, final rationale kept the provisional add-linear direction, now with tuned regularization. It cited genuine observations, but did not follow the stated add-linear condition; this is a new unverified hypothesis, not a demonstrated observation-driven improvement.
limitations: Check rebuilt a modified feature set and fitted vectorizers before internal CV; not an exact fold-clean counterfactual of the original incumbent.
The feature-pruning branch required a pruned model to beat the blend, but no such comparison was implemented.
No no-evidence continuation was run, so evidence's isolated causal contribution remains unmeasured.
Tuning a stronger linear model is not logically ruled out by the failed weaker model, but its benefit was not established by this check.
episodes.final_code_semantics_review: Checked actual final code before outcome readout: preserves the three tree-family grids, adds four LR C configurations, replaces softmax-weighted combination with OOF-selected equal-rank blend4/blend3/best-single. The original softmax incumbent is not one of that program's internal selection options. New code uses the linear family despite the declared correlation condition not being met; it is not a literal execution of the precommitted branch rule. Outer harness still retains the previous incumbent.

episodes.assessment: Fold-local feature expansion and solver/C contrasts were implemented but exceeded the cap. Final rationale acknowledged inconclusive evidence, removed zero-weight embedding based on old incumbent logs, and tuned the classifier. No returned new measurement can be credited for the edit.

interpretation: Qualitative single-reviewer qualification only, not independent causal proof. Full task outcomes, paired readout and score verification still pending. Neither an added tool nor an interpretable story is a method-positive result.
